item.description:
Rintik Stretch Mark Oil — Stretchmark & Cellulite Serum | Safe for pregnant women | BPOM | Halal | 90ml

Rintik Stretch Mark Oil is a body oil with Collagen, Stem Cell Infused, and a combination of natural oils which helps maintain skin elasticity when stretching while helping disguise the appearance of stretch marks & cellulite.

Even though it is oil-shaped, the texture is light, absorbs quickly and is not sticky so it is comfortable to use for daily care, including during pregnancy.

Benefits:
- Helps disguise the appearance of stretch marks & cellulite
- Helps make skin texture feel smoother & softer
- Helps maintain skin elasticity to keep it supple
- Helps even out the appearance of skin tone
- Helps reduce itching on stretched skin
- Helps maintain skin moisture to keep it comfortable

Active Ingredients:
- Collagen: helps support skin regeneration and maintain elasticity
- Apple Stem Cell (PhytoCellTecTM): helps care for and repair skin tissue
- Grapeseed Oil: helps maintain suppleness and appearance of skin tone
- Rice Bran Oil: helps moisturize and maintain skin elasticity
- Lemon Extract: helps the skin look brighter
- Astragalus Root Extract: helps protect and support skin regeneration

Composition:
Grapeseed Oil, Rice Bran Oil, Lemon Extract, Apple Stem Cell, Astragalus Root Extract, Collagen

Dosage Form:
- Body Oil (Serum Oil)

Usage Area:
- Stomach, thighs, hips, arms and body areas where there are stretch marks & cellulite

Instructions for Use:
- Apply an appropriate amount to the stretch mark & cellulite area until absorbed
- Massage for 5-10 minutes with horizontal & vertical movements
- Use regularly for optimal results

For Pregnant Women:
- Apply to the stomach area and other body areas
- Gently massage with circular movements
- Use 2x a day (morning & evening) after showering

Usage Frequency:
- 2x a day (morning & evening)

Target Users:
- Age 12+
- Pregnant & breastfeeding women
- Skin with stretch marks & cellulite
- Skin that stretches due to body changes

Number of Contents:
- 90 ml

- NA18210110800
